text: هدف رائع سجله رافائيل ديلاكروكس لفريق Westport Albion في الدقيقة 30 بتمريرة عرضية من ديلاين رحمن[#553]. بدأ الهجوم باسترداد الكرة من مارك زيلينسكي ثم استمرت التمريرات المباشرة والعمودية نحو الأمام، مما يبرز أسلوب الفريق الصبور والمباشر في اللعب[#535] [#550]. هذا الهدف كان فرصة كبيرة حسب تقييم xG 0.976، يعني أن الهدف ممكن يحدث في أغلب الأحيان[#553]، وتعادل النتيجة 2-2 أمام Kingsmoor FC.

- Westport Albion regained possession through an interception by Marek Zielinski near their own defensive area, initiating a controlled build-up from the back [#535].  
- Their build-up featured a mix of short and progressive passes combined with successful ball carries, moving through their midfield steadily over approximately 40 seconds and involving multiple players, indicating patient and direct vertical passing typical of their 4-4-2 formation and style under coach Grace Oduya [#536-#545].  
- The critical moment came from an effective switch to the right flank where Dylan Rahman carried the ball forward and provided a precise cross to Rafael Delacroix, who was positioned close (2 meters) to the goal, capitalizing on a high-quality chance (xG 0.976) for a close-range finish [#548-#553].  
- This goal exemplifies Westport Albion’s direct vertical passing strategy within their 4-4-2 setup, combining patient buildup with a sharp, decisive attacking move ending in a crossing assist and clinical finish, allowing them to equalize against Kingsmoor’s 4-4-2 wide, crossing-oriented side.
